method.teacher: released PhysTwin graph and per-edge spring field
method.parameterization: additive rank-16 normalized Gaussian-RBF log-stiffness field over canonical object-spring midpoints, plus one separate controller-spring coefficient
method.center_selection: deterministic farthest-point sampling initialized at the spring midpoint nearest the centroid with stable index tie-breaking
method.identity: all coefficients zero reproduces the teacher exactly in the same runner
method.selection_metric: equal mean of validation Chamfer-distance and manual-track-error ratios

source_acceptance.aggregate_requirement: equal-case selected stack improves both validation Chamfer distance and manual-track error
source_acceptance.fallback: reject the complete family and retain the exact teacher
